column1: # Hermes skills — installed from the vendor repo via the Hermes skills hub; `hermes skills update`
# refreshes them every run (live). Hermes' bundled `humanizer` (a port of blader/humanizer) is used
# as-is: never install a second copy.
# `official` = the vendor's own org (resend/, team-telnyx/, stripe/). Hermes' scanner flags normal
# API-client patterns in them (env API keys, HTTP sends); the same skills ship in the vendors' Claude
# Code plugins, so they install with --force. Community skills never get --force.
